key_structures: Main Garbhagriha with five-spire curvilinear shikharas
Garuda Mandapa (outer wooden carved pillared hall)
special_features: Kiranotsav phenomenon: twice a year the setting sun rays illuminate the deity's feet, chest, and face directly through windows
Unusual monolithic gemstone (sandstone) deity holding citrus fruit, mace, shield, and bowl crowned with a lingam and cobra
Star-shaped platform base typical of early Chalukyan engineering
renovation_history: Initiated by Chalukya King Karnadeva in 634 CE; enriched by Shilahara and Yadava dynasties; preserved and restored under Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and subsequent Maratha rulers.
